prompt: Create a highly realistic cinematic photorealistic night bedside scene with a surreal miniature person inside a clear glass of water. The subject is a sick young woman sitting curled up at the bottom of the glass, tiny in scale, wearing dark navy satin pajamas with white piping, bare feet visible, looking tired and feverish with one cheek resting on one hand. Preserve natural human proportions and detailed facial expression. Add a white fever-cooling patch on the forehead and slightly messy long wavy brown hair. The glass is centered on a warm wooden bedside table, filled with clear sparkling water containing many tiny air bubbles around the subject, with realistic refraction, distortion, highlights, and thick glass rim/base. Surround the glass with exactly 5 bedside illness items: 1 blue-and-white medicine box on the left, 1 blister pack of round pills in the lower left, 1 loose white capsule near the front left, 1 digital thermometer in the lower right displaying 38.7°C, and 1 crumpled white tissue on the right. Add 1 dark blue ceramic mug with gold crescent moon and star pattern behind the glass on the right. Background includes 1 warm table lamp with beige fabric shade on the left, softly glowing, plus a blurred alarm clock and plant in the dark room. Use shallow depth of field, warm amber lamp light mixed with cool night shadows, cinematic vertical composition, macro realism, ultra-detailed textures, cozy sick-day atmosphere, no extra people, no text except the thermometer digits, no watermark.

promptZh: 创建一个高度逼真的电影级写实夜间床头场景，画面中有一个超现实的微型人像置于透明水杯内。主体是一位生病的年轻 女性，蜷缩在杯底，比例微小，身穿深海军蓝缎面睡衣，带有白色滚边，露出赤脚，神情疲惫且发烧，单手托腮。保持自然的人体比例和细腻的面部表情。额头上贴着白色退热贴，留着微乱的长波浪 棕色头发。水杯位于温暖的木质床头柜中央，杯中盛满清澈的苏打水，主体周围环绕着许多微小的气泡，呈现出逼真的折射、畸变、高光以及厚实的杯缘和杯底。在水杯周围放置 5 件床头病患物品：左侧 1 个蓝白相间的药盒，左下方 1 板圆形药片，左前方 1 粒散落的白色胶囊，右下方 1 支显示 38.7°C 的数字体温计，以及右侧 1 团揉皱的白色纸巾。在水杯右后方放置 1 个带有金色月牙和星星图案的深蓝色陶瓷马克杯。背景包括左侧 1 盏带有米色织物灯罩的暖色台灯，散发柔和光芒，以及暗室中模糊的闹钟和植物。采用浅景深，暖琥珀色灯光与冷色夜影交织，电影级竖构图，微距写实，超细腻纹理，温馨的病假氛围，无额外人物，除体温计数字外无任何文字，无水印。
